Wonderful Breakfast Buffet with a Smile
Dec 2024 • Couples
We were staying at the Pan Pacific for three nights as part of our Viking Mekong river cruise. Aside from the Pan Pacific being a wonderful hotel, Viking made special arrangements for our breakfast buffet at the Ming restaurant. It was great to have the whole restaurant to ourselves for about 80 people. Outstanding breakfast buffet including both Western and Asian options. The woman who made Pho each morning was cheery and so very friendly though she spoke little English. The Pho was outstanding. The Asian options varied each day so you got to try different dim sums and other dishes. Plenty of pastries, fruit, juices, yogurts, etc. Can certainly get eggs.

Terrible Service
Jan 2025 • Family
We reached the restaurant at 9.30 pm and placed the order for dinner. Soup served was lukewarm warm and we had to immediately ask for it to be reheated. Dinner was nice but they missed out serving one dish in the main course and by the time it was served the rest of the food was cold. Finally when asked for water to be served for drinking it was refused.. we were told that the sorry the bar was closed and we can’t serve water. We left at 10.30 pm without dessert or water.. the staff was just waiting for us to leave and it made us leaving unwanted guests.. overall experience was very disappointing.

Fantastic place for Chinese Cuisine especially for dim sum lovers!
Mar 2023 • Couples
A fabulous Chinese Restaurant inside Pan Pacific Hotel. We wanted to have dim sums. It was the best choice. The menu is extensive and our hostess Anh was very knowledgeable so we let her bring us her recommendations. The buffet menu has everything you can imagine. We loved the shrimp and scallop dumplings. They were just perfectly steamed and crunchy. Just heavenly! Don't have breakfast so you can enjoy all that the menu has to offer. We had a feast! Great place for a big group to share. The price is very affordable compared to Singapore.

Such as great services, professional staff and delicious foods
Feb 2020
When Corona spreading rapidly to the world combine with media record/information it’s is too much panic to everyone, we even don’t want to go out at the weekend. However coming to DS restaurant at Pan Pacific hotel I have good feeling at the first side. All chefs wore mask, gloves to give best protect to clients. All the foods in here were hot enough and very yummy and were served in a professional ways by friendly and useful restaurant staffs who also wore mask to protect either clients or themselves, society. After each time clean up dishes on the table, they clean their hands to guarantee personal hygiene as well as food hygiene. It’s highly recommended to friends and family.
